description: This file contains the implementation of a MySQL driver for the ADOdb database abstraction library, including classes for database connection, metadata retrieval, and recordset handling tailored to MySQL databases.

classes.name: ADODB_mysql
classes.description: Implements MySQL database connection and metadata methods, extending ADOConnection for MySQL-specific functionality.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_mysql
classes.description: Handles MySQL recordset fetching, seeking, and metadata operations, extending ADORecordSet.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_ext_mysql
classes.description: Extended MySQL recordset class with additional MoveNext override, extending ADORecordSet_mysql.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Retrieves MySQL server version information.

methods.name: IfNull
methods.description: Returns MySQL-specific SQL snippet for null-coalescing.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Fetches metadata about tables, optionally filtered by schema and name pattern.

methods.name: MetaIndexes
methods.description: Retrieves index information for a specific table.

methods.name: qstr
methods.description: Escapes a string for safe inclusion in SQL queries.

methods.name: _insertid
methods.description: Gets the last inserted ID.

methods.name: GetOne
methods.description: Executes a query expected to return a single value.

methods.name: BeginTrans
methods.description: Stub for transaction support, indicated as not supported in this driver.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns the number of rows affected by last query.

methods.name: CreateSequence
methods.description: Creates a sequence table for generating sequential IDs.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new sequence ID for a given sequence name.

methods.name: MetaDatabases
methods.description: Lists all databases on the server, except 'mysql'.

methods.name: SQLDate
methods.description: Generates SQL for date formatting based on a specified format.

methods.name: Concat
methods.description: Returns SQL for concatenating multiple string expressions.

methods.name: OffsetDate
methods.description: Returns SQL for a date offset by a specified number of days.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Connects to MySQL database.

methods.name: _pconnect
methods.description: Persistent connection to MySQL database.

methods.name: _nconnect
methods.description: Forces a new connection to MySQL.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Retrieves metadata about columns in a specific table.

methods.name: SelectDB
methods.description: Selects the database to use.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns the last error message.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns the last error code.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the database connection.

methods.name: CharMax
methods.description: Maximum size of CHAR fields.

methods.name: TextMax
methods.description: Maximum size of TEXT fields.

methods.name: MetaForeignKeys
methods.description: Retrieves foreign key constraints for a table.
